evidence.title: Noruega: el nuevo rey rinde homenaje a su difunto padre mientras miles están de luto

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of King Haakon VIII's first speech
occurrences.quote_span: “Como rey, mi padre representó a Noruega y al pueblo noruego con orgullo y alegría, a través de visitas por todo el país, en actos aquí en este Palacio Real y mientras trabajaba en nombre de Noruega en todo el mundo”, dijo Haakon.
occurrences.speaker: King Haakon VIII of Norway
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Oslo Royal Palace visitor and condolence records and news footage
occurrences.quote_span: Decenas de miles de personas presentaron sus respetos, colocando flores y tarjetas de condolencias frente al Palacio Real en Oslo, donde el féretro llegó tarde el viernes desde el hospital.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Norwegian Royal Palace announcement and succession records
occurrences.quote_span: Su esposa se convirtió en la reina Mette-Marit, mientras que su primogénita, Ingrid Alexandra, se convirtió en princesa y heredera al trono.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of King Haakon VIII's first speech
occurrences.quote_span: “Lo voy a extrañar. Extrañaré su risa. Su manera afable de tratar con la gente y las situaciones”, añadió, tratando de contener las lágrimas mientras prometía darlo todo por el país en el futuro como su nuevo rey.
occurrences.speaker: King Haakon VIII of Norway
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of King Haakon VIII's first speech
occurrences.quote_span: Agradeció al pueblo por su muestra de compasión y recordó lo cariñoso que había sido Harald como padre y esposo.
occurrences.speaker: King Haakon VIII of Norway
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of King Haakon VIII's first speech
occurrences.quote_span: “Y eso significa —en el sentido último— estar dispuesto a arriesgarlo todo, incluso la propia vida, por la libertad y la independencia de Noruega”.
occurrences.speaker: King Haakon VIII of Norway
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Norwegian public television broadcast recording of Haakon VIII's speech
occurrences.quote_span: “Estamos de luto. Al mismo tiempo, nos reconforta y nos da fuerza saber que tantos están de luto con nosotros”, dijo el rey, vestido con un traje negro, mientras su discurso se transmitía en directo por la televisión pública.
occurrences.speaker: King Haakon VIII of Norway
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Norwegian church and municipal announcements and condolence-book records
occurrences.quote_span: En todo el país, iglesias y ayuntamientos abrieron sus puertas especialmente para que la gente pudiera encender velas y escribir sus pensamientos sobre el difunto rey en libros de condolencias.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: King Haakon VIII's first televised address and Norwegian Royal Palace death announcement
occurrences.quote_span: El rey Haakon VIII de Noruega utilizó su primer discurso como monarca para elogiar a su padre, el rey Harald V, como un padre cariñoso y un monarca dedicado, un día después de que murió a los 89 años.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of King Haakon VIII's first speech
occurrences.quote_span: “Ha sido una experiencia poderosa y conmovedora ver la plaza del Palacio llena de gente, flores, mensajes de condolencia y velas. Muchas gracias”, dijo Haakon, de 53 años, sentado en un escritorio de madera junto al retrato de su padre y dos velas blancas.
occurrences.speaker: King Haakon VIII of Norway
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Norwegian Royal Palace biography and official royal motto records
occurrences.quote_span: Haakon adoptó el lema “Todo por Noruega”, que se remonta a su bisabuelo.

evidence.title: Norway’s new King Haakon remembers ‘dear father’ Harald in first speech as sovereign

occurrences.checkable_against: Haakon VIII's first televised address to Norway
occurrences.quote_span: New monarch Haakon VIII paid an emotional tribute to his late father, Harald V, in his first address to the nation.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of Haakon VIII's televised speech
occurrences.quote_span: "We believe in our system of self-governance — and in democracy. We believe in a society built on the rule of law, where every individual has equal worth," he said.
occurrences.speaker: King Haakon VIII
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Haakon VIII's first televised address to Norway
occurrences.quote_span: Vowing to follow his own path, Haakon pledged to uphold Norway’s democracy, unity and inclusive values.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Norwegian royal family marriage records
occurrences.quote_span: He noted that his parents would have celebrated their 58th wedding anniversary on Saturday.

occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Reuters interview with Jonas Gahr Store
occurrences.quote_span: The Norwegian prime minister told Reuters news agency that Haakon shared many of his father’s qualities, particularly his "ability to create an atmosphere of togetherness."

occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of Haakon VIII's televised speech
occurrences.quote_span: "We greatly mourn his loss. At the same time, it gives us consolation and strength to know that there are so many who are grieving with us."
occurrences.speaker: King Haakon VIII
occurrences.subject: King Haakon VIII of Norway

occurrences.checkable_against: Haakon VIII's first televised address to Norway
occurrences.quote_span: Haakon said he would follow his own path, as his father did before him, while reaffirming the principles of Norway’s constitutional monarchy.
